messages:
samira: heads-up: design idea for the playground composer when responses stream. proposal: single prominent stop CTA + minimal token badge. call this 'quiet stream' — reduces clutter while output arrives. want quick feedback on semantics + accessibility. noah: i like the simplicity. important: clarify Stop semantics in copy and shortcuts. Stop should be terminal (no auto-resume). if we want resume later expose Retry. eli: agree w/ no resume mid-stream unless we have explicit support. engineering note: keep regenerate disabled until stop; backend should still retain recent context to allow immediate regenerate. analytics: emit playground_stream_{start,stop,regenerate_enabled}. mei: accessibility things: token badge needs aria-live='polite' and aria-atomic='true'. when regen is disabled provide SR-only text like "Regenerate disabled while streaming". stop button label needs to be descriptive for SRs: "Stop streaming response". samira: layout conflict: prompt library quick insert opens left rail and sometimes overlaps token badge on narrow screens. options: 1) move badge left of send 2) collapse to icon with accessible label 3) hide badge when rail open. any UX preference? noah: move left of send for most widths. if width < 400px collapse to icon+tooltip. avoid hiding entirely. eli: dev plan: add class .pg-quiet for styling variants, expose a small helper prop for collapsed state. keyboard: Esc stops, Esc after stop does nothing; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to submit new messages. i'll add a feature flag while we test. mei: aria example to hand off: 
<button id=\"stop\" aria-label=\"Stop streaming response (Esc)\">Stop</button>
<span id=\"tokens\" role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\">Tokens: 248</span>
<span class=\"sr-only\" aria-live=\"polite\">Regenerate disabled while streaming</span>
samira: visual microcopy suggestions: button tooltip "Stop response (Esc)", disabled regenerate tooltip "Regenerate after stopping", token badge "Tokens: 248". when streaming add a faint pill "streaming" next to badge. noah: for network hiccups show inline small status: "Stream interrupted retry" (retry tries to resume if response metadata says resumable). if not resumable, fallback to stop. will add can_resume flag from backend. eli: action items: 1) design mock two variants (left-badge, collapsed icon) @mei 2) add .pg-quiet class + shortcut behavior @eli 3) a11y review for SR messaging and contrast @mei 4) finalize copy and QA checklist @noah. aim for a small experiment next week. mei: i'll run voiceover/TalkBack checks on the two mocks and post results. samira: perfect — i'll drop Figma frames here when ready. thanks!
